implementation.targetScope: String conversion and recursive own enumerable object-key conversion, including sparse arrays and unchanged Date/RegExp values

source: Written from public README examples and black-box observations. No upstream runtime source read or copied. Cycles throw a named TypeError instead of overflowing the call stack. Date/RegExp preservation is realm-independent; custom toStringTag values cannot spoof built-in brands or force a getter read.
